---
id: king-cobra
title: King cobra
---
The king cobra (*Ophiophagus hannah*) is the longest venomous snake. It
eats other snakes, including other cobras. When threatened it rears,
flattens a narrow hood, and growls. Females mound leaf litter over eggs
and remain nearby. Neurotoxic venom targets breathing. Forests from
India through Southeast Asia hold the remaining populations.
